275002137.description:
Glass Insulator Lot - 3 Pieces
Hemingray and American Manufactured
Aqua Teal and Clear, Vintage Mid-Century Era
This collection of three vintage glass insulators represents a significant era in American telecommunications history. Used primarily to insulate telegraph and telephone wires from their wooden support poles, these heavy glass pieces are prized by collectors for their industrial aesthetic and vibrant glass colors. This lot provides a balanced display including a classic aqua teal piece and two clear glass specimens.
Pieces Included:
Hemingray Insulator, Aqua Teal Glass, embossed "HEMINGRAY" with beaded drip points - minor base fleabites
Clear Glass Insulator, embossed "MADE IN U.S.A.", smooth base - excellent vintage condition
Unmarked Clear Glass Insulator, smooth base - excellent vintage condition
Condition:
The lot is in very good vintage condition. The teal Hemingray insulator shows typical minor chipping and roughness along the drip points on the base, which is characteristic of utility-grade glass. The clear insulators are notably well-preserved with no significant chips or cracks. All pieces retain their original glossy transparency without signs of glass disease or mineral cloudiness.

277737410.description:
Vintage Glass Insulators - 3 Pieces
Pressed Glass, Aqua and Clear
Vintage, Made in U.S.A.
Collection of three vintage glass telephone or telegraph insulators, including one in a classic aqua blue-green and two in clear glass. These heavy industrial artifacts were a staple of early telecommunications infrastructure and have become popular collectibles due to their sculptural forms and light-refracting properties.
Pieces Included:
Aqua glass insulator, approximately 4 inches tall, beaded drip edge base, marked "MADE IN U.S.A."
Clear glass insulator, approximately 4 inches tall, beaded drip edge base, marked "MADE IN U.S.A."
Clear glass insulator, approximately 4 inches tall, smooth base rim, marked "MADE IN U.S.A."
Condition:
Overall good vintage condition. All pieces show internal rust staining and surface accumulation within the threaded centers from former utility use. The glass remains structurally sound without major cracks. Minor fleabites, surface scuffs, or small chips common to salvaged glass insulators may be present. All markings are molded into the glass.

277462901.description:
Natural Mineral & Fossil Specimen Lot
Mixed Collection of Stones, Fossils, and Lithic Artifacts
Approximately 125 Pieces, 4 Pounds Total Weight
A comprehensive collection of geological and paleontological specimens suitable for educational displays or starter collections. This lot features a broad variety of natural history, ranging from prehistoric marine fossils to semi-precious gemstones in both raw and polished states. The inclusion of knapped stone points adds an archaeological element to this extensive and diverse assembly.
Diverse mineral assortment including quartz clusters, amethyst, rose quartz, pyrite, and jasper
Prehistoric fossil collection featuring crinoid stem segments, gastropod shells, and shark teeth
Archaeological style lithic artifacts including several knapped stone arrowheads in various colors
Mixed finishes with both raw, rough specimens and tumbled/polished pocket stones
Condition:
All items are in natural geological condition. Fossils show expected mineralization and structural details. Polished stones have smooth surfaces. Raw minerals and crystals retain their natural edges and matrix. Knapped points appear intact with sharp edges. Total lot weight is 4 pounds.
